name: Bethany Birches Camp – Summit (Summit Mid & Summit High)
description_short: Summit is Bethany Birches Camp's overnight program for older campers in Plymouth, Vermont, with Sunday to Friday weeks: Summit Mid for ages 11-14 and Summit High for ages 13-16. Campers get more free time, spend time outdoors and cook meals over the fire. Families pick one of five price tiers; the two lowest are for households that qualify by income.

refund_policy_summary: A $50 nonrefundable deposit holds a spot and counts toward the total. Full payment is due 3 weeks before the session. Cancel in writing 3 or more weeks ahead and the payment, less the deposit, stays on account for another program within a year. Later cancellations and no-shows get nothing back or forwarded.
